cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Keep the Peace
cards.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle the missing savings. It's a banking complication. You keep our anniversary reservation; I'll have everything in order by Friday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you lend your sister money again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The money's coming back. We can choose somewhere cheaper tonight if you'd rather. Last time we argued about her, you wanted separate bedrooms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave the calls to me. You choose the restaurant, and I'll fit the booking around you. We can have a perfectly ordinary anniversary. I need us still sharing a table when Friday comes.
